## RelayDesk · intake and specialist agents
Core orchestration lives on this canvas. Demo mode uses rules; Live mode calls three native LangChain/Ollama specialist chains. Model outputs never execute actions.

Import credentials with the setup script; do not paste secrets into nodes.

## Review before action
This workflow only saves a needs_review ticket. The portal performs a version-checked operator approval, then queues one handoff. The separate handoff workflow handles approved events.

Inspect execution data only in your private local instance.
